quarterly_data.quarter: Disco Corporation TDnet: Business Forecast Notification (10-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Disco disclosed its previously undisclosed forecast for April-December 2026 (cumulative to the third quarter of the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027): consolidated net sales JPY 389.5 billion, operating income JPY 174.7 billion, ordinary income JPY 173.4 billion and net income attributable to owners of parent JPY 121.9 billion (net income per share JPY 1,123.43); non-consolidated net sales JPY 322.5 billion, operating income JPY 144.0 billion, ordinary income JPY 169.5 billion and net income JPY 124.5 billion. The cumulative shipment forecast is JPY 434.2 billion for April-December 2026. The company discloses forecasts only for one upcoming quarter because drastic and rapid fluctuations in customer willingness to invest make demand in the semiconductor and electronic components industries hard to predict.
quarterly_data.figure: Apr-Dec 2026 forecast: net sales JPY 389.5 billion; operating income JPY 174.7 billion; shipments JPY 434.2 billion
